title: Construct selected rank-two Pauli fusion and bound its uniform transfer bill
body:
## Concrete result

The first literal sequential candidate handed off by [PR #3975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3975) has an exact finite fusion: replace its two rank-one target calls by the rank-two endpoint recipe and implement the intervening donor transfer with four rational array ADDs and six monomial source maps. The arbitrary dirty donor is restored and no new vector register is used. A fresh checker proves the complete 1024-column two-register boundary, including global phase.

The transfer is B=((1+i)I+(1-i)P)/2, where P is the explicit signed-XOR Pauli with xor224/sign-mask96. The positive finite identity has a precise lifting cost: at tensor multiplicity f, a direct read-only-donor monomial accumulation needs exactly 2^f transfer channels. The literal array bill is at least V·2^f, not a constant native-adapter invoice. Its internal physical ADDs are a new macro contract; the inherited common-frame scalar-word checker is not claimed to admit the new sequence.

Two exact donor-retiming alternatives also fail their optimistic recursive budgets. Immediate restoration increases normalized charge by 2^(1-a); deferral to the donor's next actual child forces width 3 and increases it by 3^(1-a)-1. Both are positive for 0<a<1. A separate operator-algebra proof excludes one arbitrary operator call plus coordinate-uniform scalar mixing: the required blocks I,B,C span dimension3, witnessed by determinant(1+i)/4. Additional coordinate-dependent coupled adapters remain outside that class.

## Scope and evidence

Canonical main20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90; priority revision 6. Only `research/selected-rank2-intertwiner` is added. This pairs native Clifford algebra with linear-systems transfer maps and operator-space dimension. It resolves a specific sequential caller and does not repeat the 35-candidate screen or the heterogeneous simultaneous-child census.

The standard-library Gaussian-rational checker authenticates all 597 source events, checks all 512 columns of each child/correction map and all 1024 block inputs, verifies both exact width 3 recipes, the finite Pauli schedule, and five rejection controls. Normal and optimized registered replays pass. The proof extends the algebraic identities and scoped support bounds to all positive tensor multiplicities; it is not an inherited all-size supplier admission. No selected cold replay or κ improvement is claimed.

## Credit and remaining work

Gonzalo Mier/[PR #3975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3975) supplied this sequential handoff. Credit Cinna Davis/[PR #1836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1836), Adam Gall's heterogeneous interface audit and its [PR #1920](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1920)/[PR #679](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/679) predecessors for related interface and volume-billing lessons; retain the selected [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) lineage. The two correction recipes were generated with the preserved inherited Clifford compiler and independently decoded by this fresh checker. Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and a separate Codex mathematical review; Apache-2.0. No human or formal-kernel acceptance claimed.

A productive next attempt must specify a coordinate-dependent coupled native macro, its actual operand volumes, boundary charts, dirty restoration and full bill. Repeating endpoint matches or granting the 2^f transfer expansion a constant invoice does not close that gap.
